findings.text: gate-base-importers.aborted.log, kept as 'an earlier attempt of the same arm, aborted by its harness timeout without a summary', ends with a complete summary line '55 failed, 803 passed, 8 errors in 1590.27s' and EXIT=1, and diffing it against gate-head-importers.log shows it is the head arm's run, differing only in pytest temp-dir names, so the file carries a head-revision reading under a header naming revision 63b51b8 and tree base-tree-imp; no measure depends on it, but a reader cannot tell the companion from the head arm.
